rounds: Getting a job through a friend is perfectly fair.
A job interview tells you very little about how good someone will be.
It’s fine to exaggerate a little on your CV.
Your network matters more than your grades when you look for a job.
Companies should be allowed to check job applicants’ social media.
The best person for a job is usually the one with the most experience.
I would turn down a dream job if I didn’t like the team.
